description: React component for configuring rate limiting settings in a chat flow, including enabling/disabling rate limit, setting message limit, duration, and message, with save functionality and API integration.

classes.name: RateLimit
classes.description: React functional component for managing rate limit configuration in a chat flow.

methods.name: formatObj
methods.description: Prepares the API configuration object based on current state and dialog properties.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles toggle of rate limit enable/disable.

methods.name: checkDisabled
methods.description: Determines if the save button should be disabled based on input validation.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the rate limit configuration via API and updates state, with snackbar notifications.

methods.name: onTextChanged
methods.description: Updates state for input fields based on user input.

methods.name: textField
methods.description: Renders input fields for rate limit parameters.
